hypothesis: A source-only planner can derive bounded formula envelopes and shared neighboring context without known-document/ref special cases, while retaining prior whole-item target identities and provenance; generic lexical conservation is excluded.
scope: Generic context planning and structurally safe reinsertion/replay on already exposed native providers only; no new model inference or unseen holdout in this step.
baseline: Original frozen provider documents and their stock Markdown; no cumulative best-of historical model outputs.
success_measures: Every relevant item inventoried with ready/member/abstain/unsupported outcome; no hidden denominator removal
Whole target, member and context source references remain separately attributable
Formula envelope covers verified same-page parent and all formula children
Cross-page charspan-complete source-positive paragraphs retain eligibility; ambiguity stays explicit
No lexical gate false abstention on frozen positives
Adapter rejects stale, foreign, overlapping or context-consuming replacements; outside content and original graph unchanged
Old model output may be used only for explicitly identical input/prompt/scope replay or isolated legacy adapter regression; never reported as fresh candidate inference
selection_guard: Structural planning success is not source semantic success. If applicable positive regressions or unresolved boundaries fail, no challenger is selected for holdout.
